meta.title: Add guide on using EXPLAIN ANALYZE in PostgreSQL
meta.body_summary: Add a documentation guide on using EXPLAIN ANALYZE in PostgreSQL to diagnose slow queries, with Neon-specific options and Local File Cache section.

perf_labels.notes: Devin contributed a performance diagnostic guide but received no human review; closed after ~44h without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 596 changed lines across 5 files, this is a medium-sized documentation addition. The change is concentrated in the new guide markdown file (566 of 596 lines). The lack of any human review or merge activity suggests the PR was closed without acceptance.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal reviews or human comments were provided. The PR was closed after approximately 44 hours with no maintainer engagement, likely due to inactivity or lack of interest.
review_details.performance_claim: Guide on using EXPLAIN ANALYZE to diagnose slow queries, including Neon-specific options and Local File Cache usage.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed after 44 hours without human review or comments; no merge activity.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Documentation PRs for performance diagnostics may require domain expertise and maintainer acceptance. Devin produced a substantial guide but failed to attract reviewer attention, and the PR was closed without merge.

core_change_summary.description: Added a comprehensive guide in content/guides/using-explain-analyze-postgresql.md explaining EXPLAIN ANALYZE usage, query plan interpretation, Neon-specific options, Local File Cache, and vacuum/analyze. The guide is accompanied by an author entry for 'Neon' in authors/data.json and a profile image.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Author metadata cycled from 'Lina Byte' to 'Neon Guide' to 'Neon', with corresponding image additions and removals (lina-byte.jpg, neon-guide.jpg, neon.jpg). The PR also underwent automated Prettier formatting.
change_trajectory: Initial commit adds the guide with 316 lines and author 'Lina Byte'.
Subsequent commits add and then change the author avatar images (lina-byte.jpg, neon-guide.jpg, neon.jpg).
Author name changed from 'Lina Byte' to 'Neon Guide' and finally to 'Neon' with profile update.
Further commits expanded the guide with Neon-specific EXPLAIN options, vacuum/analyze sections, and Local File Cache explanation.
No human review comments; automated Prettier formatting applied by CI.
